prompt:
Create one high-resolution, straight-on UI presentation board with THREE complete mobile screens for the fictional Custra complaint-registration app: Profile, Saved addresses, Add address. These screens complete the approved reference design. Inherit its very minimal warm ivory/white surfaces, muted sage buttons with DARK slate labels, mist blue accents, readable navy/slate text, fine rules, quiet typography, consistent line icons and the recognizable folded-C Custra logo recolored in soft sage/teal. Preserve logo structure, not saturated blue. Equal tall mobile frames about 390x844 CSS proportions, subtle frame lines, small external captions. No device photography, no illustrations, no giant profile hero or repeated explanatory banners.

IMPORTANT: bottom navigation always reads EXACTLY Home · Products · Complaints with house, product-box, and complaint-document icons. Do not use Appointments. Profile and Addresses are entered through the header profile menu rather than a fourth bottom tab; keep all bottom tabs neutral on these account subpages. Keep a back arrow so user returns to their previous screen.

SCREEN 1 PROFILE: compact top row back arrow and small Custra logo. Modest heading 'Profile'. A small circular initial avatar 'D' alongside 'Demo Customer'; no large avatar or upload-photo control. Under it a simple edit form with three normal slim labeled fields:
'Full name' value 'Demo Customer'
'Phone number' value '+91 00000 00000'
'Email' value 'demo@example.test'
A modest full-width muted sage 'Save changes' button with dark label; editable form fields not huge boxed sections. Below a thin divider, one flat row with location-pin icon 'Saved addresses', secondary 'Home · Pune', and right chevron. Below another thin divider one quiet text action with logout icon 'Log out'. Do not invent password reset, social login, subscriptions, notification settings, language switches or account deletion. A single tiny helper 'Used to register your complaints.' can sit under form, no extra informational panel. Comfortable blank space and bottom nav Home Products Complaints, no selected tab.

SCREEN 2 SAVED ADDRESSES: back arrow and compact Custra logo. Heading 'Addresses'. Small '+ Add address' action near heading. Two flat address records separated by fine rules, not giant colored cards:
First record location/home icon 'Home', small sage 'Default' badge, address '12 Sample Lane', 'Pune, Maharashtra · 411001', 'India', simple 'Edit' text link right.
Second record building icon 'Work', address '24 Example Road', 'Pune, Maharashtra · 411002', 'India', simple 'Edit' link and secondary 'Set as default' action below record.
No deletion controls, maps, location permission prompt, giant confirmation banners or appointment lists. Tiny single line below records 'Default address is preselected for new complaints.' Make Home default explicit by text, not color only. Keep page sparse and useful. Bottom Home Products Complaints, no selected tab.

SCREEN 3 ADD ADDRESS: back arrow and compact Custra logo, title 'Add address'. Slim compact form with visible labels and normal touch controls, fits a viewport:
'Label' with THREE small selectable outlined chips 'Home', 'Work', 'Other', Home selected in muted sage. Under Other support a custom label when chosen; do not render extra field when Home selected. This maps to one address-label value.
'Address line 1' field '12 Sample Lane'
'Address line 2 (optional)' field placeholder 'Apartment, floor or landmark'
Then compact TWO-COLUMN row labeled 'City' value 'Pune' and 'State' value 'Maharashtra'.
Next TWO-COLUMN row 'PIN code' value '411001' and 'Country' value 'India' dropdown.
A checkbox row 'Use as default address', unchecked.
Muted sage full-width 'Save address' button with dark text, and small 'Cancel' text action. No use current location, no map or unsupported address lookup, no new required phone/name fields on address form. Bottom Home Products Complaints, neutral. Editing uses the same form with title Edit address and action Save changes, no extra screen needed.

All values are fictional and visibly generic. Keep a coherent familiar product interface and clear accessible states. User purpose: save details once, reuse them to register complaints with minimal effort. Don't make forms look like desktop dashboards. Keep all content fully visible, consistent margins, controls and sizing. Do not introduce new page sections or marketing copy.
notes: Profile, Saved addresses and shared add/edit address form; pending user approval.
Home Products Complaints navigation; neutral tab states on account subpages.
Fictional phone is placeholder, not usable contact data.
Existing source model requires country, region and postalCode; design preserves these inputs.
Generated links/field borders drift brighter blue than approved muted theme: implementation should use established muted teal tokens, not literal sample pixels.
Default-address saving should reuse existing owner profile default logic; no address delete or geolocation added.
approval_scope: User approved Profile, Saved addresses and Add/Edit address layout: Looks good.
